title: Spark-Harvest Hound
text: Spark-Harvest Hound sniffs out charged equipment and bites until the current changes owners. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Its tail wags only when a circuit dies.

defeatReward.text: Spark-Harvest Hound is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
